LanguageData.RWS_Report_OpenTip: Open a single-colony summary of lifetime totals, peak records, scope ranks, coverage, and static HTML export (read-only).
LanguageData.RWS_Report_ExportHtmlTip: Write a self-contained static HTML summary file for this colony to the exports folder.
LanguageData.RWS_Report_HtmlFooterNote: Read-only report generated from recorded saves and checkpoints. Missing or unmeasured values are shown as unknown and never treated as zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Report_BannerExcluded: This colony is excluded from cross-colony totals and rankings.
LanguageData.RWS_Report_BannerOutOfScope: This colony is outside the active group ({0}), so cross-colony ranks are not computed in this view.
LanguageData.RWS_Report_BannerEndingOnly: Recorded only from ending traces (no saved or live observation point); game days, wealth, and counters remain unknown rather than 0.
LanguageData.RWS_Report_RecoveredEndingsNote: {0} recovered lineage ending(s) (dev mode unknown, excluded from totals)
LanguageData.RWS_Report_DevOnlyEndingsNote: Development-mode endings are hidden by the current setting
